name: Nonaka Takako
source:
One day, a mysterious woman suddenly attacks Yuuji. She probably is a married woman, since she mentioned her husband.

She is kind of quiet and her expression is dark, so it is very scary when she comes at you.

[spoiler]She sees her husband cheat on her with Yukari. The affair did not go the whole way because he suffers from erectile dysfunction. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/tmhv.html]official site[/url]]
